entries.description: An intentional family community on 40 acres in Mississippi with 2 resident lesbians (and 2 non-resident members), offering training in earth survival skills and organic gardening, welcoming new members, children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SILVER CIRCLE FARM c/o Gwen O Demeter, Rt 5 Box 100, Holly Springs, MS 38635. We are presently two wimmin living on the land and two wimmin living in different cities who share financial/emotional responsibilities for caretaking 40 acres. We are an intentional family of four who enjoy the support of several other extended family members who visit regularly to help with the farmwork and enjoy its special energy. Our interests include spiritual tolerance and development, organic farming, prosperity thinking and being, networking, and providing a working example of an alternative to patriarchal patterns. We give training in survival back to the earth skills: organic gardening, woodswomanship, natural healing, carpentry, plumbing, etc. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs on leash. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity, outhouse, running water in kitchen, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.

entries.description: A 250-acre women's land trust near Monticello, Kentucky, with 33 residents, dedicated to holding land in perpetuity, growing organic food, skill education, and community living, welcoming new members, girl children, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SPIRAL WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 337, Monticello, KY 42633 (606)348-5215 (7 mi from Monticello). Spiral is an all wimmin's space, open to membership. Supportive Membership is for wimmin to use the land for camping/workshops or just to be supportive. Community Membership entitles one to live here, be part of the community and own one's own improvements. In brief, our purposes say: To hold land in perpetuity, for wimmin to form community, to grow food organically, to provide education of alternative skills, etc. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 30 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians, 250 acres, 1 house, 1 barn, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_location_as_stated: NW Michigan 1 hr from Traverse City - Jordan River Valley
entries.description: A spiritual lesbian feminist intentional community on 40 acres in northwestern Michigan with 6 residents, sharing incomes and vegetarian space, centered on nature-connected spirituality, healing, and sanctuary, welcoming women of color and girl children.
entries.raw_text: O.W.L. SANCTUARY Rt 1 Box 209-A, E Jordan, MI 49727 (616)536-2903 (NW Michigan 1 hr from Traverse City - Jordan River Valley). In May '85 land, with two smallish houses, a barn, apple trees, critters and nature spirits, was purchased. We see our primary focus as a spiritual one, experiencing and developing our psychic, spiritual and nature-all inter-connectedness with a commitment to aid the healing of the Earth Mother. Our spirituality is eclectic in its background and manifestations, but has a decidedly Lesbian Feminist emphasis. The community space is considered basically vegetarian and incomes are shared. Future goals include sponsoring wimmin's gatherings and events, creating ongoing Lesbian spiritual circles, establishing a liaison with area Native wimmin and offering a healing, contemplative space to wimmin needing sanctuary. We welcome: new members/residents in Fall '86, wimmin of color, girl children, dogs. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living on the land.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Atwood, on Lake Michigan in NW lower peninsula
entries.description: A clean, sober, and nicotine-free homestead on 70 acres in Atwood, Michigan, lived on by 2 lesbians planning a woodworking collective, berry and fruit farm, and writer's hermitage, welcoming new members, girl children, and Native American women and other dykes of color.
entries.raw_text: MAPLE ROW FARM Rt 1 Box 88, Ellsworth, MI 49729 (616)599-2013 (Atwood, on Lake Michigan in NW lower peninsula). We live in a clean and sober, nicotine-free 80-year-old stone cabin with 2 cats. We have a car, truck and motorcycle, a 30' x 50' garden, a foundation for another building, and septic and electrical hookups available for a trailer. Many adjoining acreages for sale. Visions are for a woodworking collective, berry and fruit farm, writer's hermitage, and horses once the land is paid off (Dec '86). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, Native American Women, other dykes of color, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 70 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
